paragraphs: Mar Ukban, son of R' Yose.
R' Nehemiah, his son — Yevamot, chapter 14, halakhah 1.[^1][^2]

notes.text: בריה in the second unit means “his son,” referring to the heading figure, rather than an omitted father-name. The heading itself gives Ukban as Yose’s son.

פ״יד ה״א gives chapter 14, halakhah 1. The format suggests the Jerusalem Talmud, but no corpus or edition is explicitly named or independently checked. Mar is full; the other two personal titles remain R'.
